column4: From one operator-authored Dhall specification the shipped render-examples, compile, and apply commands freeze, decode, lower, plan, provision, render, chain, dry-run, and apply it through a separate fake kubectl process image. The runner rewrites the rendered example after the run starts, planting a nonce in the authored names and changing the replica count, and recovers the nonce from every stage artefact. The independent oracle judges every stage artefact of the corpus examples and of that run from literals, the fake's per-step stdin bytes concatenate to the compile output, and every refusal is observed at its exact tag and stage. Witness-driven rendering, capacity over application workloads beyond fit, substrates other than kind on one host, extensions, children, and the UI language are excluded.
